Known history is shallow but dense: some four centuries, counted in '''A.U.''' — ''after the Unification''. The ancestors were there; letters, swords, graves and scars still exist. And in the middle of this fresh, documented past lies a black hole.

* [[War of the Unification]] — the war with three names
* [[Ash Oath]] — ten seals; some say eleven
* [[The Silent Year]] — years 3–4 A.U., an unnatural emptiness
* [[Timeline of the Banner-lands]] — the anchor pillars
* [[The 400-year jubilee]] — four years away, and counting
* [[The eleventh house]] — the realm's oldest rumor
